overall_reason: Tailwind with a shadcn role set and a parallel --color-hp-* palette, built with 705 arbitrary-value utilities: the first screen shows two near-identical muted greys, radii of 8 to 22px in half-pixel steps, and a dark mode partly written as literal arbitrary classes.

score.reason: T-FRAMEWORK-FIT fails on bracketed one-offs and parallel role sets; T-VALUE-INVENTORY and T-DRIFT-PAIRS fail on radii and greys; T-THEME-PARITY finds 77 literal colours in dark rules (TOK-011, TOK-004, TOK-010, TOK-009).

findings.evidence: The stylesheet carries 705 arbitrary-value selectors (rounded-t-[5px], rounded-t-[8px], rounded-t-[10px], rounded-t-[14px], rounded-t-[16px], h-[11px], h-[12px], h-[13px], leading-[1.2], leading-[1.3]) and 176 of 263 font-size declarations are bracketed one-offs (declarations.by_family.font_size arbitrary_utility).
findings.before: Bracketed values typed past the Tailwind scale
findings.after: Add the needed steps to the Tailwind theme once and use the named utilities
findings.why: Every bracketed value is a decision made per element, so the scale stops describing the product.
findings.root: arbitrary utilities instead of theme steps

findings.evidence: Twenty radii render: the hero link 8px, the nav buttons 10px, the hero CTAs 14px, the sticky nav 18px, the FAQ rows 22px, plus 8.5, 9, 12 and 20px elsewhere (values.1440.radius). The sweep's card_kit hit names three card recipes at 8, 12 and 22px.
findings.after: Three radii (control, card, pill) from the theme
findings.why: Same-kind buttons and rows with different corners read as parts from different kits.

findings.evidence: Two muted paragraphs on the first screen use #6a6e78 (hero p.mt-5) and #676b75 (p.text-center.text-muted-foreground), 0.010 OKLab apart, and a third muted grey #5f6570 appears in the product panel; headings pair #111111 with #141413 (values.1440.colour_text near_duplicates).
findings.why: Two greys a hair apart split one role into two values that drift further with each edit.

findings.evidence: The .dark selector redefines 105 base tokens, but dark rules also set 77 literal colours through arbitrary classes such as dark:border-[#2a2a2a], dark:border-[#2d2f2f] and dark:border-[#3a3935] (theme.dark_rules_colour_declarations), and 14 semantic colour tokens (--color-background, --color-foreground, --color-muted) are not redefined.
findings.before: Dark borders typed per element as literals
findings.after: The dark block redefines --border, --background, --foreground and --muted, and the dark: arbitrary classes go
findings.why: Each new component needs its own dark override, so the dark theme breaks with every addition.

findings.evidence: Two colour sets run side by side: 20 shadcn roles (--card, --muted, --foreground) and an own --color-hp-* palette; --card and --card-foreground hold literal values, and the sweep's stock_swatches hit flags --color-muted #f3f4f6, --color-hp-body #374151 and --color-hp-line #e5e7eb as Tailwind defaults.
findings.before: shadcn roles beside --color-hp-* with overlapping jobs
findings.after: One role set; the hp palette maps onto the shadcn role names
findings.why: Two role sets for the same surfaces let components pick either and drift apart.

findings.evidence: Text renders at 19 sizes, including 12.5 and 13.5px between 12, 13 and 14px and a 17px step beside 16 and 18px (values.1440.font_size near_duplicates; the sweep's type_ladder hit lists all 19).
findings.after: Small text on three steps of the Tailwind scale (12, 14, 16px)
findings.why: Half-pixel steps are invisible and multiply the sizes each component can pick.

strengths: Shadows are 99.6% token references (229 of 230 declarations).
Spacing sits on a 4px scale (share 0.944 against chance 0.3), mostly through Tailwind steps.
Most colour declarations reference tokens (855 var against 105 plain literals).
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table
the dark theme as rendered: the capture shows the light scheme
the product panels (booking widgets) are partly exhibits; their values were counted but weighed less
